caption: The drawing features a rectangular grid composed of numerous small, evenly spaced red marks arranged on a beige or off-white background. The red marks are organized in a recurring, checkerboard-like pattern that creates geometric, stair-step and concentric rectangular shapes radiating outward from the center of the rectangle. The red marks are relatively uniform in size and closely placed, forming the illusion of depth and texture. The edges of the rectangular grid are straight and parallel, set against a plain, blank background. A signature in cursive is visible near the bottom right corner of the drawing. There are some small blotches and faint marks elsewhere on the background, but no other visible objects or colors apart from the red and beige.
title: Woolen Coverlet
